ignoreValues.reason: Not a card side accent: .row.is-drop-before/.is-drop-after are TRANSIENT drop-position indicators on a reorderable list, added and removed by ui/row-reorder.js (lines 131-132, 77) for the duration of a drag only. The side IS the information -- a line on the top edge means the dragged row lands above this one, on the bottom edge below it -- so it is a literal, domain-appropriate use rather than decoration. The CSS comment above them already argues why the three drag states use three DIFFERENT properties (a dashed border belongs to .row.is-shadowed, so borrowing it would make a healthy dragged row look like one that never fires).
